units: <cite ref="Sukkah 6b:12">Succ. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>ס׳ בעיא קרא</he> that the Succah must be covered does require a special intimation, v. <cite ref="O00907">preced.</cite>; <cite ref="Zevachim 38a:1">Zeb. 38ᵃ</cite> <he>וחד לס׳</he> (Rashi: <he>לסְכָךְ</he>) and one ‘succoth’ in the text is needed for intimating that the Succah must be covered.

senses.gloss: pl. סְכָכוֹת (v. סְכָךְ) the case of overhanging boughs in one of which there is a seat of uncleanness. Ohol. VIII, 2, expl. אילן המיסך וכ׳, v. סָכַךְ; Tosef. ib. IX, 3; Naz. VII, 3; ib. 54ᵇ, a. e.
units: <cite ref="Niddah 68b:48">Nidd. 68ᵇ</cite> <he>נזיר שהילך</he> (<he>ע״ג</he>) <he>ס׳ וכ׳</he> a Nazarite that passed over unclean boughs or protruding stones; <cite ref="Tosefta Niddah 9:13">Tosef. ib. IX, 13</cite>, <he>יושב ע״ג סכך</he> (v. <cite ref="O00906"><he>סְכָךְ</he></cite>); a. fr.
